title: A low-crystalline ruthenium nano-layer supported on praseodymium oxide as an active catalyst for ammonia synthesis

metal_loading.location: SI Figure S1 catalyst label; SI section 1.1 states Ru loading was fixed at 5 wt% for each catalyst

loading.location: SI Figure S1 catalyst label; SI section 1.1

records.preparation: Pr6O11 support prepared by precipitation, dried at 70 °C, calcined at 700 °C for 5 h; impregnated with Ru3(CO)12 in THF; dried at 70 °C for 4 h under air; heated to 350 °C under Ar and held for 5 h.

space_velocity.location: SI section 1.2 Activity tests; applies to H2/N2 = 3 activity-test series

time_on_stream.location: SI section 1.2 Activity tests: temperature kept constant for 0.5 h to facilitate measurement of NH3 synthesis rates

rate.location: SI Figure S1, x-axis 'NH3 synthesis rate (μmol g–1 h–1)'; value read from Ru/Pr2O3 (5 wt%) bar

records.notes: Only the Ru/Pr2O3 bar in SI Figure S1 is this paper's catalyst-performance data; Ru/C12A7:e− and Ru/HT-C12A7:e− bars are reproduced from references and were not extracted.

extraction_notes: SI Figure S1 provides one readable ammonia synthesis rate for this paper (Ru/Pr2O3); the two electride-supported catalyst rates are explicitly reproduced from Ref. [S3] and were excluded. SI Figure S3 reports cumulative NH3 amount versus time for Ru/Pr2O3, not an NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF, so no performance record was extracted from it.
